title: Collatz: full-denominator count, nonlocal repair, and actual stopping mass
body:
## Current checkpoint: four direct closing attacks

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This pass used three parallel researchers plus the principal researcher to attack actual source descent, the same-orbit entropy bridge, source-retaining sibling transport, and arbitrary positive cycles. No universal descent, escape exclusion, or complete nontrivial-cycle exclusion was obtained.

Published head: `8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73`  
Tree: `ff254b2e3e29d0122dc9ae0bf3ddb1115c32e203`  
Parent: `08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d`

[Scientific entry point](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/README.md) · [Whole-repository inventory](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/REPOSITORY_SNAPSHOT.json) · [Late PR refresh](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/LATE_REFRESH.json) · [Validation and scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/VALIDATION.md)

The metadata pass covered all 145 open and closed PRs, with targeted reading of the current scientific frontier. PR180 advanced during the work to `5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2`; its new source surgery and weighted routing were incorporated before publication. This is not a claim to have re-audited every proof in every branch.

## 1. Bound the actual full-denominator zero atom

For every positive cycle with shortcut length A, p odd steps, minimum m and whole denominator D=2^A−3^p>0, the new finite Lean module proves

```text
D(3m+1) <= p 2^A.
```

With M=floor((p2^A−D)/(3D)), the written ordinary-word correspondence and cycle-minimum injection give

```text
N_0(A,p) <= A * #{m <= M : gcd(m,6)=1}.
```

This bound allows arbitrary parity words, valuation alphabets and description complexity. The classical Matveev specialization makes the count polynomial in numeric A. It also gives a complete polynomial-time minimum census as a function of numeric A, with an enormous worst-case degree; no claim of polynomial complexity in log A is made. This is a deduction from cycle-minimum/logarithmic-form machinery, not a new transcendence theorem.

The missing closing threshold is N_0<A: one primitive A-cycle contributes A distinct rotations. A polynomial numerator over an exponential word count still permits that cycle.

[Written proof and exact failed closing step](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/ZERO_ATOM_CLOSING_ATTEMPT.md) · [Lean module](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/CycleMinimum.lean) · [Complete minimum-census implementation](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/zero_atom.py) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/REVIEW_ZERO_ATOM_CLOSING_ATTEMPT.md)

## 2. Allow arbitrary nonlocal prefix repairs

Retain the original target, its actual suffix and the supplied complete source clock A. If a positive integral edited state y at clock b can follow that suffix to a safe endpoint, then

```text
2^(A-b) divides x_b-y,   x_b > 2^(A-b),
5*2^A < 6*3^(o_b)*t,   o_b >= r-2.
```

For bounded-four source words this forces b>=A/4−2, independent of the altered prefix's description complexity.

The all-certificate record S=1092, t=2047 exposes the proposed payment failure. The first positive integral copied-tail repair occurs at clock 18, from current target 112103 to repaired state 7. Its lower-grade powered source 28 pays only up to 57. The imported all-certificate maximum 1092 excludes every permitted-grade completion at the feasible cuts through this source clock. The actual target later descends at clock 58; it is not a counterexample.

Fresh PR180's source-only positive-carry surgery still needs the original interval slack; its new arbitrary-prefix accounting does not supply that activation.

[Nonlocal repair proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/NONLOCAL_SURPLUS_REPAIR_ATTEMPT.md) · [Fresh source-surgery comparison](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/LATE_LEGAL_DESCENT_COMPARISON.md) · [Exact finite control](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/surplus-repair-control.json)

## 3. Keep the actual obstacle-payoff measure during sibling repair

Unequal-depth inverse transports retain an exact terminal-height ratio. On a stipulated escaping ordinary orbit q_k, high-payoff stopping antichains concentrate in their own critical payoff on the single inverse prefix passing a sufficiently late fixed anchor q_K.

Consequently, for every fixed eta>0,

```text
V^[r](q_k) >= eta*q_k  implies  r >= k-K_eta.
```

The freshest PR180 common-precision routing certificate still has coefficient c/(3^(r+1)*sqrt b), so this particular certificate is exponentially small in k on those witnesses. This is not an upper bound on actual sibling mass and does not exclude another adaptive transport. The reciprocal terminal-distortion estimate required by OPEN-F/OPEN-S remains open. All canonical harmonic/envelope inputs retain their source qualifications.

[Unequal-depth transport, payoff concentration and witness-depth proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/UNEQUAL_DEPTH_SIBLING_ATTEMPT.md) · [Scoped reconstruction review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/INTEGRATION_REVIEWS.md)

## 4. Retain the original integer in periodic-shadow arithmetic

For the actual parity prefix matching uv^infinity through L bits, put a=|u| and N=|u|+|v|. The exact shadow numerator obeys

```text
D*x_0-Z = 2^N*(x_a-x_N).
```

For a nonperiodic source this is a nonzero integer divisible by 2^L. Hence

```text
L <= N + log_2(1 + max_(j<=N) x_j).
```

This can rule out sufficiently strong actual repetition, but the latest time-law entropy ceiling supplies neither that repetition nor the fixed local factor-complexity hypothesis of the inspected Subspace argument. An explicit two-rotation binary control tests the general entropy-to-repetition implication. It is not an ordinary Collatz orbit and is not asserted to realize every compact-joining property.

[Fixed-source proof and literature interface](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/closing/FIXED_SOURCE_SHADOW_ENTROPY.md) · [Independent arithmetic review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/REVIEW_FIXED_SOURCE_SHADOW_ENTROPY.md) · [Symbolic-control review and exact boundaries](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/8a8b1eea6c9fdfbce7b0bbf0af4eb771791e3a73/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov22/closing/INTEGRATION_REVIEWS.md)

## First missing closing implications

A permitted complete source must still pay the actual target interval or provide original-target descent; the real sibling transport must retain enough of a specified spike; the actual forward entropy law must force a contradictory ordinary-source property; and the all-word zero count must fall below the primitive-cycle threshold. None of those final implications is asserted by this checkpoint.

## Current checkpoint: three parallel machinery attacks

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint proves new statements at the actual closing interfaces and adds a substantive Lean arithmetic module. It does not prove that the escaping-component charge vanishes, original-target descent for arbitrary adaptive words, or absence of every nontrivial positive cycle.

### 1. The latest PR177 commutator is evaluated exactly

PR177 advanced during this work to `e4ca639326bac73da8c2a698dec8a749e5efbe68`. Its S-unit argument gives upper Banach density zero for bounded binary-run times on escape, while its canonical energy calculation leaves the commutator in equation (47). The new proof shows that its boundary-drift term tends to zero **uniformly over finite Green depth M**, for each fixed truncated run weight `w_L=min(rho^runs,rho^L)`.

The entire commutator then has the exact asymptotic:

```text
lim_(N→∞) sup_(M≥1) C_(N,M)(w_L)
  = 2 rho^L b_infinity
    - 2 sum_(E escaping) F_E sum_(x∈E) d(x) w_L(x).
```

The subtracted term is bounded independently of L by the finite original-charge forcing. The coefficient `2*b_infinity` survives. The proof pays both signs of the boundary drift using `(L(nu*R_M^2)-nu*R_M^2)^- <= 2d`, and retains the original canonical charge throughout. This resolves the displayed commutator; it does not produce the cutoff-uniform upper bound needed for escape exclusion.

[Exact proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/EXACT_RUN_WEIGHT_COMMUTATOR.md)

### 2. Actual moving ordinary fibres

For each original nonperiodic positive odd ternary unit p, with retained `q_k=U^k p`, the new scalar theorem is

```text
lim_(R→∞) sup_(k:q_k retained) (1/R) sum_(r<R)
  |D_(k+r+1)(q_k)/h(q_k) - 1| = 0.
```

The joint real/ternary theorem controls the **mean of per-depth bounded-Lipschitz distances**, uniformly in the same moving clock. It keeps the final ternary digit, negative centered contact shifts, real normalization, and original `n^-4` source labels.

This is a written deduction conditional on the exact ordinary mean-absolute trace in Valbuena's pinned manuscript `a7275d5a73814d3d9a400c6fe6577de9542b03a3` and the pinned repository contact/envelope construction. The source statement and normalization were read independently; its external analytic/formal dependencies were not replayed. The theorem contains an explicit positive original-source submeasure conditional on escape.

[Moving-fibre proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/MOVING_CESARO_FIBRES.md)

The tilted-renewal attack also gives the exact square-weighted row identity and uniform budget

```text
T_j(q) = sum_(U^j x=q) A_j(x)^2,
sum_(j≥0) T_j(q)/q^2 <= zeta(2).
```

Every depth block therefore has mean at most `zeta(2)/R`, uniformly in the nonperiodic ordinary root. A rigorous scalar-tail comparison leaves a finite ordinary first-entry term, whose aligned moving Cesàro limit is identified exactly and still contains the original escaping ancestor.

[Tilted renewal and finite immigration](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/TILTED_RENEWAL_FINITE_IMMIGRATION.md)

### 3. Lean proves exact block integrality and finite inverse recursion

For every affine block `(u*x+c)/v`, with `u>1` and coprime integer u,v, the new module proves

```text
(exists q in Z, v^e*m = u^e*q + c_e)
    iff u^e divides ((v-u)*m-c).
```

It proves uniqueness, the zero-defect fixed-source exception, an effective exponent bound, an executable exact inverse finite set, its iff membership theorem, and exact finite-list recursion for arbitrarily independent repetition exponents. `Block.ofCounts` proves the arithmetic hypotheses for `u=3^s`, `v=2^L`, `s>0`.

[Lean source](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/BoundedLanguage.lean) · [Separate audit](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/BoundedLanguageAudit.lean) · [Word-level theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/BOUNDED_LANGUAGE_SOURCE_RIGIDITY.md)

The written extension rules out cofinal bounded-gap complete-source coverage by a fixed bounded language, or by a regular language consisting entirely of valid complete words to a fixed endpoint. A regular superset and finite control with unbounded arithmetic memory are explicitly excluded from that conclusion.

### Published arithmetic machinery and adaptive inverse words

Corvaja–Zannier (2002), Theorem 2 and Corollary 1, now give a complete classification for each fixed affine block schema: infinitely many integral **full cycle quotients** force one constant quotient. The proof supplies root-group confinement and the full numerator/denominator bidegree argument. It retains fixed buffers and the possible repeated nontrivial cycle.

[Fixed-block cycle theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/FIXED_BLOCK_INTEGRAL_RIGIDITY.md) · [Regular cycle-language consequence](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/08fe1388ad63c758680b3695249aca319515c47d/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/machinery/REGULAR_CYCLE_LANGUAGE_COROLLARY.md)

The sibling attack constructs a changed-word injection of actual inverse trees and proves `V^[r](y) >= 16^(-r) V^[r](x)` for retained roots in the same ternary residue. Its improved signed repair cost is exactly a paired terminal-height ratio. No adequate bound on that ratio or obstacle depth was obtained.
